The synthesis begins with joint modeling (0433) to extract structured signals from multi-dimensional play data, including YPP, sacks, and win outcomes. These are then mapped into calibrated intervals using interval heads (0473), which improve upon raw ratings by incorporating auxiliary continuous outcomes. Clustered bootstrap (0503) addresses distribution shift by generating independent samples, improving reliability of interval estimates. Finally, exact calibration discipline (0564) ensures that predicted probabilities align with empirical frequencies, enabling trust-based scheduling rather than theorem-based quoting. This progression reflects a dual failure mode: first, binary-only models lose signal; second, uncalibrated intervals mislead. The closed loop ensures each step corrects prior inadequacies.
